statement: Formal etaleness descends through an open subset of a flat base change that is fpqc over the source
notes: Paired-first-base maps on the overlap factor through the same open branch because their nilpotent reductions coincide. No descent of actual modularity is asserted.

statement: Under conditions1-7 every generization of an actual modular point on a finite-type test is Artinian formally etale
notes: Finite complete-base branch is actual at its closed point and triggers7; its flat local map to the original local test is faithfully flat.

statement: Under conditions1-6 and8 a generically Artinian-formally-etale closed stratum contains a nonempty relative open of such points
notes: Generic quotient base is Artinian, so8 has an actual modular premise there. One uniform finite thickening reflects pro-hull maps at later points; weaker etale8 uses a finite etale residue lift.

statement: The actual modularity locus is open for every locally finite-type test under original1-8, without local representing schemes
notes: L1 settled positively. The maximal open of Artinian-formally-etale points contains every actual modular point; its represented etale open image is a separated locally quasi-finite scheme. This does not assert existence of modular models at every field point and does not negate A:main-counterexample.
